arm.role: the sealed flight: every arm below is a column of it

aa.role: the in-flight twin: replicate_of lock, the null of every contrast

lock.role: the delivering arm: LEFT of every contrast (the locked template, untemplated)

boundary: A development read on a TRAIN fold (owner decisions 28 and 86); never a test claim; node-local, never a system-level claim. No utterance text, transcript, gold label or model output is printed or persisted.

caveats: Different flights have different request-level offsets; the same-flight twin null of either flight does not bound a cross-flight difference (the lock-minus-lock row is the descriptor).
r1-c5 was the best of five arms on this same roster in iteration 1 (winner's curse); a positive difference is not evidence of superiority and a negative one is not evidence of harm.
Iteration 1's r1-c5 does not fly in iteration 2: this table is the only place the two rounds meet, and it gates nothing.
cross_iteration_contrast.contrast: each iteration-2 arm X (r1-i2-c1, r1-i2-c2, r1-i2-c3, r1-i2-c4, r1-i2-c5) minus iteration-1 r1-c5, the iteration-1 arm that cleared the node screen; plus iteration-2 lock minus iteration-1 lock as the flight-offset descriptor of the unchanged locked template
cross_iteration_contrast.node_local_pass: read by hand from the two node-local reports on file (iteration 1: analysis/SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-NX-R1-SOLVER-FOLD-B-COLUMN-READ-V1/node-local; iteration 2: analysis/SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-NX-R1-I2-SOLVER-FOLD-B-COLUMN-READ-V1/node-local); no new driver

official_pass.driver: scripts/analysis/stage3_paired_read.py (column arms, left run = iteration 1, right run = iteration 2; non-gating; skipped with a notice when iteration 1's official column scoring is absent)
official_pass.right: each iteration-2 arm, and lock against iteration-1 lock

cross_iteration_contrast.same_row_set: the 1,080 TRAIN Fold B sample ids of both flights
cross_iteration_contrast.status: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY: no claim, no nomination, no input to the decision rule

decision_rule: SAME-FLIGHT NODE-TEMPLATE COLUMN READ (NX programme C0.2/C2 R1 iteration 2; instrument E1/E2; claim ceiling 'nominated'). One flight, one Solver visit per row, seven arms over the SAME QueryState and evidence: r1-i2-c1 .. r1-i2-c5 (hand-written candidates), aa (the twin, replicate_of lock) and lock (the locked template, delivering, last). NOMINATION IS DECIDED ON THE OFFICIAL COLUMN. Each arm's first-visit Solver answer is rendered through the delivered row's normaliser and projection and scored ONCE with slurp-slu-official-train (never sharded); every contrast is the paired ROW bootstrap of that arm's column against the delivering lock arm (cluster key sample_id, 10,000 draws, seed 20260915; scripts/analysis/stage3_rollout_score.py then stage3_paired_read.py), all read within this one flight. NOMINATION RULE: candidate X is NOMINATED iff (a) the official pooled SLU-F1 delta X minus lock has a CI95 lower bound > 0, AND (b) that delta is above the aa twin's official pooled SLU-F1 delta (aa minus lock, same flight), AND (c) the intent guard holds: rows whose official intent correctness differs from lock <= 7 (the floor 0.65 pp of 1,080). HARM iff the official pooled SLU-F1 delta CI95 upper bound < 0. The twin null (aa minus lock) is read first and reported beside the design's provisional floor (SLU-F1 1.49 pp, intent 0.65 pp at n = 1,080; borrowed from same-flight-supply-variant until this cell measures its own null). Among several NOMINATED arms the largest official SLU-F1 delta wins (ties: fewer words). THE NODE-LOCAL READ IS DIAGNOSTIC AND GATES NOTHING: the E2 reader (schema v2; scripts/analysis/slurp_nx_solver_column_read.py) reports exact_set_normalised (the entity exact-set per row of the answer after the delivered row's own normaliser), parse_valid, empty_gold_false_fill, nonempty_exact, per-slot-type counts and the raw-vs-normalised flip table, paired per row against lock, to localise where an official delta comes from; a node-local gain without an official gain is not a nomination, and a nomination needs no node-local screen. (Why: in iteration 1 the node-local screen and the official column disagreed: normalised node-local c5 +1.30 [-0.19, +2.78] vs official -0.15 [-1.23, +0.89]; c3 +4.63 [+2.87, +6.39] vs official +0.96 [-0.16, +2.09].) PLATEAU RULE (programme C0.4): two evaluated rounds without a NOMINATED arm lock the delivering template and close the node. A nomination is confirmed once on TRAIN Fold A as a two-arm column before any lock; it admits nothing by itself. The delivering lock arm's own offline post-processing columns v4 and v4g are read beside (analysis recipe, offline_columns). THIS IS THE SECOND AND LAST EVALUATED ROUND of R1 under the plateau rule: if no arm is NOMINATED here the delivering template is locked and the node closes. The iteration-1 arm r1-c5 does NOT fly in this column; each iteration-2 arm is also set beside iteration-1 r1-c5 in a cross-iteration table that is DESCRIPTIVE only (different flights, different offsets: no claim, no nomination, no input to the rule above). Iteration 1's registered rule and verdict stand as written.

node_local.primary_definition: the entity exact-set per row of the answer AFTER the cell's own delivery normaliser, derived by stage3_rollout_score.normalise_arm_answer (the official column scorer's function)
node_local.role: diagnostic: localises where an official delta comes from; gates nothing

nomination.contrast: candidate minus the delivering lock arm, paired per row, same flight
nomination.harm_iff: the official pooled SLU-F1 delta CI95 upper bound < 0
nomination.metric: official pooled SLU-F1 (slurp-slu-official-train) of the arm's column
nominated_iff: the official pooled SLU-F1 delta (candidate minus lock) has a CI95 lower bound > 0
that delta is above the aa twin's official pooled SLU-F1 delta (aa minus lock, same flight)

nomination.tie_break: largest official SLU-F1 delta, then fewer words

bootstrap.unit: row (paired); the whole-utterance number is the node-local and offline reads' own

v4.definition: the five-rule set of docs/results/2026-10-09-slurp-nx-postprocessing-v4-offline-read.md section 6, in the registered order

v4g.definition: v4 with the two TRAIN-only guards ee-wilson and ti-expressible of docs/results/2026-10-09-slurp-nx-postprocessing-v4-audio-attribution.md section 4

offline_columns.driver_interface_status: the rule definitions and their offline selection live in scripts/analysis/slurp_nx_postproc_v4_search.py (the separate agent's driver); the application of the REGISTERED normalisers saea-deliver-normalise-v4 / -v4g to a sealed column is scripts/analysis/slurp_nx_postproc_v4_apply.py --apply v4|v4g --pool <run>/<attempt> [--column <arm id>] (on master since merge 7bfc09b3b). KNOWN BLOCKER: that driver refuses any run whose roster intersects TRAIN Fold B ('Fold B is not read by this script'); the R1 run IS Fold B, so the refusal must be lifted for this one recipe before the offline step can run (nx_r1_read.sh reports it and exits 10 rather than skipping silently)

lock_rule_row.rule: The R1 delivering-arm (lock) column on TRAIN Fold B is the FRESH CONFIRMATION roster for v4g (the guards were derived from Fold A and A2 attribution, so neither can confirm them): lock v4g iff the CI95 lower bound of the paired pooled SLU-F1 delta is above 0 here.

offline_columns.note: 0 GPU, zero model contacts. Two deterministic delivery-normaliser variants applied OFFLINE to every arm's delivered column; the cell's runtime delivery normaliser stays the COMP-1b module cell's (saea-deliver-normalise-v3) and neither variant is wired into the cell.

review_off_vs_full_graph.contrast: the delivering lock arm of this flight (review-off, Fold B) vs the P-SV-3 a-agree DELIVERED column on the same Fold B
review_off_vs_full_graph.offset_bound: the P-SV-3 t-twin offset (flight offset between two identical-request flights)
review_off_vs_full_graph.rule: If the lock arm minus the P-SV-3 a-agree delivered column is within the bar (2.5 pp; the P-SV-3 t-twin offset reported beside as the flight-offset bound), review-off is locked (owner decision 232 / programme F2); if the full graph wins by more than 1.49 pp SLU with CI95 lower bound > 0 the drop is revisited. Cross-flight and therefore never a gating number of this flight's column read.

steps: 0. Refuse unless the READ row SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-NX-R1-I2-SOLVER-FOLD-B-COLUMN-READ-V1 is root countersigned.

1. Refuse unless the flight carries a COMPLETE sealed 1,080-row manifest with one complete official TRAIN score and the saea-supply-variant-arms-v4 receipt on every row, verified by the bundle (invariant I7v).

2. Node-local (E2, schema v2; DIAGNOSTIC, gates nothing): per arm, on the answer after the cell's own delivery normaliser (primary exact_set_normalised) and on the raw answer (diagnostic), parse validity, entity exact-set, empty-gold false fill, non-empty exact and per-slot-type counts, paired per row against lock, whole-utterance bootstrap and paired Wilson; plus the per-arm raw-vs-normalised flip table.
3. Official: render each arm's first-visit Solver answer through the delivered row's normaliser and projection and score it ONCE with slurp-slu-official-train (seven jobs, never sharded).

4. Twin null (aa vs lock) first, then each candidate vs lock on the OFFICIAL pooled SLU-F1 column (nomination rule: CI95 lower bound > 0, above the aa delta, intent guard 0.65 pp, within the flight); per-scenario tables.
5. Offline v4 / v4g columns over every arm's delivered column (0 GPU), the lock row v4g(lock) - lock being the v4g confirmation.
6. The review-off vs full-graph comparison against the P-SV-3 a-agree delivered column (cross-flight; no extra flight).
7. Iteration 2 only, DESCRIPTIVE: each iteration-2 arm and lock against iteration-1 r1-c5 / lock (cross-flight; gates nothing; recipe cross_iteration_contrast).
